ov: Three species of large, slow, fully aquatic plant-eating mammals, sometimes called sea cows, with paddle-shaped tails. They live in shallow coastal waters and rivers of the Caribbean, the Gulf of Mexico, the Amazon and West Africa.
rg: The Caribbean, the Gulf of Mexico, the Amazon basin and West Africa.
df: Over 60 kinds of freshwater and saltwater plants.

cf.tip: The dugong is the manatee’s only living relative, found in the Eastern Hemisphere.

fx: Its curiosity and slow speed make it prone to collisions with boat propellers.
